_comment: Copy to controller/config.json (gitignored) and fill in host paths. Harnesses are not shipped: install each from its official channel. Only the harness of the system being run is checked. Each harness entry is a host directory, mounted read-only in the container at the path in _mount; the versions below are the ones this benchmark was tested with. A system can name another entry with "harness_install" in systems.json (gpt6_astra uses codex_astra, a newer Codex CLI).

_harness_layout.codex: directory with the codex binary (and codex-code-mode-host); mounted at /opt/native; tested: codex-cli 0.147.0 (x86_64 musl standalone)
_harness_layout.antigravity: directory with the agy binary; mounted at /opt/agy; tested: agy 1.4.0
_harness_layout.claude: directory with the claude binary; mounted at /opt/claude; tested: Claude Code 2.1.301 (native x86_64-linux)
_harness_layout.dsh: npm prefix holding node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh (runs on the image's node); mounted at /opt/dsh-runtime; tested: @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.1-rc.2
_harness_layout.kimi: npm prefix holding node_modules/@moonshot-ai/kimi-code (runs on the image's node 24); mounted at /opt/kimi; tested: @moonshot-ai/kimi-code 2.2.0
_harness_layout.zcode: directory with zcode.cjs (the CLI's dist/); mounted at /opt/zcode; tested: ZCode CLI 0.17.0
_harness_layout.codex_astra: like codex; used by systems whose systems.json entry says "harness_install": "codex_astra" (gpt6_astra); tested: codex-cli 0.162.1

_fields.docker_host: optional DOCKER_HOST (empty: docker's default or your environment)
_fields.ffmpeg_dir: optional directory put first on PATH: the delivery checker runs ffmpeg/ffprobe on the host
